decision.reason: Staging/production logs or telemetry covering seven days for assistant POST clients are not available to the executor.
decision.riskAccepted: Residual risk of an unknown external assistant client is accepted only as a documented migration risk. The migration must still stop if future logs show any unlisted assistant message client before cutover.
decision.rule: Only clients in knownRuntimeClients are treated as approved known clients for this migration checkpoint. This does not prove external clients are absent.

approvedIdempotencyPlan.requiredChange: Generate a UUID X-Idempotency-Key per intentional assistant send, keep the same key for retry/reconnect of the same message, create a new key for a new intentional send, and send it on sync/SSE POSTs.
approvedIdempotencyPlan.nodeCompatibility: Node must ignore the header during coexistence.
approvedIdempotencyPlan.pythonCompatibility: Python may require the header only when the validated plan contains PDF/artifact generation, exactly as Phase 13.20 states.
approvedIdempotencyPlan.requiredBefore: routing assistant PDF/artifact traffic to Python

unknownClientPolicy.decisionForFutureUnknownClient: If any future staging/production log before cutover shows an assistant message POST client not represented in knownRuntimeClients, stop the migration, identify owner, update compatibility plan, add/adjust contract tests, and only then continue.

staticScanRules.rule: Any production web reference to assistant message POST paths must be represented by knownRuntimeClients.

futureRequiredControls: Phase 2.9 must introduce structured request logging that can support future client inventory without cookies, prompts or request bodies.
Before staging/cutover, logs for assistant message endpoints must include method, normalizedPath, status, timestamp, origin/host, sanitized user-agent and request id.
Phase 13.20 must update the known web client to send X-Idempotency-Key and test retry/reconnect/new-send semantics.
Python must not make X-Idempotency-Key optional for PDF/artifact generation because of absent historical logs.
If any future log shows an unlisted assistant message client, the migration must stop until owner and idempotency compatibility are documented.
